leverage.exposure: Balance is positive right now and there is no open leveraged position. The recommended move deliberately opens one: the buy takes the balance negative and it stays negative until the funding sale settles. That gap is intended to last minutes, not hours. A negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the entire matchday, so the sale must follow the buy immediately and must in any case be complete well before the lock. The buy price is capped by that unwind, not by cash and not by the floor — the ceiling is what the funding sale returns plus the balance on hand, and the recommended raise sits comfortably under it.

binding_gap: Attack. The eleven fills its only legal shape, so there is no hole to plug; the binding constraint is quality at the third attacking slot, where the incumbent is running at roughly four times the cost per fielded point of the man being bid for. The swap is worth a three-figure points gain per matchday and is the entire case for taking on temporary leverage.

verdict.detail: One action, still unexecuted: raise the live Mokwa offer, then instant-sell Conté the moment it lands. The offer has sat at its original figure since the afternoon run and resolves overnight, so this is the last briefing that can realistically reach Georg before the auction closes. Everything else on the board is noise.

sell.reason: Conté, conditional and only in this order: the Mokwa auction must land FIRST. If it is lost the sale must not happen — the squad would fall to ten and take the short-squad penalty. If it lands, instant-sell to Kickbase immediately, and do it before tomorrow evening's market-value update so the figure that clears is the one this briefing is sized against. This is a capacity sale, not a fitness one: Conté is fit, was a merit-based starter under Ilzer, and the only cloud is Lemperle's return pressuring his place. He is simply the worst points-per-euro in the eleven and the swap is like-for-like at attacker.

buy.reason: Mokwa, raised. The standing bid sits in the premium band that has already lost this league two auctions — Banks and Makengo both went at bids near this level, and both times the ledger's advice not to raise was the direct cause. A Kickbase listing is highest-bid-wins, not seller's choice, so raising genuinely buys win probability; and the visible offer count is a snapshot, never a forecast of who arrives in the remaining hours. The raise target sits above every contested Kickbase clearing price measured in this league bar the three outliers, and still leaves unwind headroom under the hard ceiling. New evidence this run points the same way: Petkov cleared to a rival at a premium in the same contested cluster. Nothing else on the board is buyable — the genuinely good defenders and midfielders all price above the single-sale ceiling, and the affordable names are zero-appearance bodies or manager markups.

Ligainsider's own Mokwa player page reports 2 Bundesliga starts out of 2 matchdays, 195 league minutes, 2 goals, 0 assists, and no injury item newer than preseason (Erkaeltung 15.08.2026, angeschlagen 27.07.2026, "bereit" 20.08.2026 - all stale by the date-trap rule). A projection that inverts its own club's usage data on two players at once is a broken instrument, not dated selection evidence. Ar95t3l itself recorded the honest case for reversing (fit, not injured, 84% of minutes, "a rotation forward omitted from one projection, not a benching") and declined only because the condition was literal. This run judges the condition unmeetable-by-construction while that page stays frozen, and MD3 kicks off 2026-09-13T15:30Z. THE COST IS ZERO IN POINTS TERMS: the unwind self-funds. 333.904 - 9.500.000 = -9.166.096, then Conte at mv 10.096.062 (mvt 1 rising, sdmvt +1.454.448, and tonight's 20:00Z update should lift it further) returns +929.966, eleven bodies, 4-3-3 legal. Ceiling before the balance breaks is about 10.430.000, so 9.500.000 keeps a real margin. POINTS: Mokwa ap 149 replaces Conte ap 47 in the fielded eleven, +102, XI ap 1342 to 1444, at 46k per point against Conte's 215k. Listing is a Kickbase board listing at exactly mv, ofc 1 with only Georg in ofs - uncontested as a snapshot, which after Makengo is explicitly NOT a forecast.

Three of the asks that are live are the same seller's habitual buy-and-mark-up, at premiums many times what manager-to-manager business actually clears at in this league; a fourth belongs to a new imitator. Rivals are churning unavailable players for fractions of a percent on the daily tick — that is motion, not points, and it is not worth copying with the eleven this tight.
